a.text: ア is an axe swinging down – “ah!”

i.text: イ is a painter’s easel leaning on its stand – “ee”.

u.text: Like hiragana う, but square: a U with a little hat.

e.text: エ is an elevator shaft between two floors – “e”.

o.text: オ is an opera singer with arms out – “oh!” Like お without the loop.

ka.text: Just like hiragana か, minus the little extra stroke.

ki.text: Like き, a key – but without the bottom curve.

ku.text: ク is a cook’s bent arm stirring – “ku”. Compare ケ and タ.

ke.text: ケ is a keg tipped over, with a line through it – “ke”.

ko.text: コ is two corners of a box – “ko”.

sa.text: サ looks like hiragana さ sitting up straight – “sa”.

shi.text: Two eyes on the LEFT and a smile drawn UPWARD from the bottom: シ. (ツ has the eyes on top.)

su.text: ス is a superhero with a flowing cape – “su”.

se.text: Like hiragana せ – a mouth with a fang: “say”.

so.text: A needle sewing DOWN from the top: ソ. (ン’s line goes up from the bottom.)

ta.text: Like ク with an extra line inside – “ta”.

chi.text: チ is a cheerleader with arms out – “chi”.

tsu.text: Two dots ON TOP and a wave falling DOWN: ツ. (シ has the dots on the left.)

te.text: テ is a telephone pole with its crossbar – “te”.

to.text: ト is a totem pole with one branch – “to”.

na.text: ナ is a cross, like the cross in hiragana な – “na”.

ni.text: ニ looks like the kanji 二 (two), which is read “ni”!

nu.text: ヌ is chopsticks picking up a noodle – “nu”.

ne.text: ネ is a person wearing a necklace – “ne”.

no.text: ノ is one stroke crossing something out – “no!”

ha.text: ハ is two lines bursting into laughter – “ha ha”.

hi.text: ヒ looks like a high heel lying on its side – “hi”.

fu.text: フ is a simple flag/foot shape – “fu”. Like part of ふ.

he.text: Identical to hiragana へ – the volcano peak.

ho.text: ホ is a cross with two side lines – “ho”. Like the right side of ほ.

mi.text: Three lines, like 三 (three)… whose native reading starts with “mi” (みっつ).

me.text: メ is an X – “X marks me”.

mo.text: Like hiragana も, without the curl – more fish!

ya.text: ヤ is a yak’s horn – “ya”. Like hiragana や.

yo.text: ヨ is a backwards E – three yo-yos hanging.

ra.text: ラ is a simple rabbit ear and body – like ら.

ru.text: ル is two roots growing down – “ru”.

re.text: レ is a check mark ✓ on a letter – “re”.

ro.text: ロ is a square box – “ro”. (Looks like the kanji 口, mouth.)

wa.text: ワ is the bowl of a wine glass – “wa”. Compare ウ (has a dot) and フ.

wo.text: ヲ is ヨ with a tail – “whoa”. Very rare in katakana.

n.text: ン’s line goes UP from the bottom (like a smile). ソ’s goes down.
